title: Intelligence Brief
subtitle: Anthropic expanded Claude Cowork from desktop-only, The drafter-reviewer agent pattern that emerged in, meetily's third straight day of rising GitHub velo

insights.text: Anthropic expanded Claude Cowork from desktop-only to mobile and web with background cloud execution (tasks continue even when device is offline), mobile approval redirects, and a unified chat/Cowork interface. Less than 9% of sessions are coding; ~50% are business operations and content creation.

The drafter-reviewer agent pattern (one agent drafts, a second with fresh context critiques) that emerged in coding workflows is now appearing in non-engineering domains — ai-job-search applies it to CV + cover letter generation with structured fit evaluation.

meetily's third straight day of rising GitHub velocity (+1,409 → +2,494 → +1,777/day sustained) validates privacy-first local transcription as structural adoption, not a launch spike. 20,987 total stars; Rust + local Whisper/Parakeet.

TencentCloud/CubeSandbox debuts at +664/day (8,554) — fourth major-vendor sandbox implementation in one quarter (Monty/Pydantic, LiteBox/Microsoft, OpenSandbox/Alibaba, CubeSandbox/Tencent). Sandbox layer is now table-stakes.

Rowboat (Show HN, 125 pts) is an open-source, local-first alternative to Claude Desktop — knowledge graph of your work + built-in surfaces (email, notes, browser, code, meetings). YC-backed. Directly addresses cloud-vs-local agent tension.

Kokoro TTS trending on HN (#8, 351 pts) as 'local, CPU-friendly, high-quality TTS' — second CPU-only TTS option within 24 hours of Pocket TTS. On-device speech synthesis is now a multi-option category, not a single-product niche.

30papers.com (HN #11, 433 pts) — Ilya Sutskever's 30 essential ML papers in beginner-friendly format. A non-code, non-product resource hitting the front page signals ML-literacy demand is a standalone audience.

Herdr sustains trending (HN #13, 217 pts/101 comments) — 'one terminal to rule them all.' Terminal multiplexer for agents, day 7 across three tracking days. The tmux-for-agents workflow is a maturing product category.

takeaway.text: Claude Cowork broke out of the desktop into mobile/web with background cloud execution and push-notification approvals, while the drafter-reviewer agent pattern escaped engineering into job hunting and meetily proved privacy-first local transcription has structural GitHub velocity.
